title: The Largest Desert on Earth Is Covered in Ice
description: A desert is defined by how little rain or snow it gets, not by heat. That makes Antarctica the biggest one.

scenes.text: The largest desert in the world is not hot or sandy. It is Antarctica.
scenes.subject: antarctica
scenes.say: The largest desert in the world is not hot or sandy. [gasps] It is ANTARCTICA.

scenes.text: A desert is any place that gets very little rain or snow each year. Heat has nothing to do with it.
scenes.say: A desert is any place that gets very little rain or snow each year. Heat has nothing to do with it.

scenes.text: The middle of Antarctica gets less yearly snowfall than many famous hot deserts get in rain.
scenes.subject: antarctica
scenes.say: [whispers] The middle of Antarctica gets less yearly snowfall than many famous hot deserts get in rain.

scenes.text: The ice is there because it almost never melts. It has built up slowly over hundreds of thousands of years.
